# Steam — camp production and mission type discussion

- Original source: [Steam — camp production and mission type discussion](https://steamcommunity.com/app/46560/discussions/0/682990896046756433/)
- Author / publication: mikasautasa and Mr.Kitchee / Steam Community
- Language / date: English; displayed January 9 opening and February 8 reply, years omitted
- Access: Opening and sole reply inspected through direct HTML retrieval
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

The opener reports that characters do not heal or craft between missions. Mr.Kitchee replies that camp characters produce nothing unless the completed operation is a primary mission or castle siege.

This supplies a concrete mission-type hypothesis for production timing. The thread does not establish whether that reply also explains healing, and the opener does not post a confirmation.

Compare this report with walkthrough descriptions and actual campaign events before treating the claimed restriction as universal. The build, mission sequence, and camp assignments are not specified.
